lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin. The clusters are organized in approximately vertical columns with consistent local spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a discernible matrix of high-intensity nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to a lower-intensity shadow region below.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, elongated, high-luminance feature (remora) is attached to the lower lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the pelvic region.
